assets.name: Danger
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one custom fantasy MMORPG world-map marker icon for HardcoreBuddy, not a mockup. A square image with genuinely transparent alpha background. One isolated centered emblem occupying 85% of the image; crisp compact silhouette, chunky simple forms that remain legible when reduced to 22 pixels. Hand-painted metal with minimal bevel highlights, dark charcoal edging for contrast over a parchment map. No square frame, no circular badge, no background panel, no text, no letters, no other icons, no cast shadow beyond the emblem. No fine filigree, no tiny details, no glow cloud. A dangerous enemy marker: three thick diagonal crimson claw slashes cut into a compact dark iron claw-shaped emblem, fiery red highlights, visually clear aggressive three-stroke silhouette.
